item.description: Europe #4743 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The Argyreoi made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Europe has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: A child for the House of Pelorus: Ostemedes Ersonides ~1427, born to Erson #760 the Blood-handed and Thrasos #8031. It will grow old; its parents will not. Erson is the cruel now.

item.description: Europe #4743 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Erson #760 the Blood-handed carved Thrasos #8031's name into a rib-bone and gave it away.
item.description: Erson #760 the Blood-handed carved Thrasos #8031's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now. Erson is the cruel now.
